title: Michelle
style: folk, country, melodic, acoustic, electro, world, bright
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Hey there
Michelle
It's your song pal line
Droppin' a track to say you're doin' just fine
I'm sendin' this letter just to let you know
You're a superstar wife and the star of the show
From the heart of the family
The ultimate cool
Makin' your own lane
Breakin' every rule

[Verse 2]
You got the message
Corey
Thanks for the call
Right out on the patio
Playin' some balls
I'm tendin' the garden and diggin' the dirt
With a racket in hand
In my comfortable shirt

[Chorus]
Oh
Michelle
The coolest around
Best in the family
The truest we've found
With a racket in your hand or a plant in the land
You're rockin' your world just exactly as planned
Yeah
We all want to say you're the star of the show
Our favorite song pal
Just thought you should know

[Verse 3]
Mom is the champion
Out on the court
Pickleball queen
She loves the sport
Wesley and Ruby are cheerin' her name
Watchin' our awesome mom win every game
Out in the garden
Makin' everything green
The prettiest backyard that we've ever seen

[Verse 4]
Then you hit the court and the competition falls
Rulin' the baseline
Crushin' pickleball
Servin' up aces
Then waterin' the seeds
You're exactly the hype that this whole family needs

[Outro]
So here's a little replay from your pen pal crew
A special delivery dedicated to you
Keep bein' awesome
Keep shinin' so bright
Corey and the kids say you're doin' it right
